strings.en: Know the name of the one who brings your end./　I am Karo-Ran Vui.
Know the folly of standing before me.
Are you prepared?
I shall deal with you myself.
I shall guide you into the dark prison.
The shadow carries tidings of death.
Those who obstruct me shall perish.
Obstacles are only to be removed.
Go and follow E-Selda.
I shall punish you in the Knight Commander's stead.
Atone with your life for aiding/　the Assimilation Plan.
Whatever form it takes,/　a fake is still a fake.
It's useless to draw out power with a fake.
One key is all that is needed./　Much less a counterfeit.
Even if you pick up our technology,/　Earthlings cannot bring out its true worth.
Son of E-Selda. I am your father's killer.
Even if the Throne Unit takes its true form,/　its rider is still too green.
Shana-Mia, you are unfit to rule.
The key to the Gate of Voda shall be mine...!
I will not hesitate, Shana-Mia.
I must clean up after that plan.
The test unit's role is already over.
Every product of the Assimilation Plan/　shall be erased.
Fall into the darkness of Voda/　along with Al-Van.
Any countermeasure to Larseilam/　must be crushed.
I return this.
You were far too rash.
That recklessness will cost you your life.
Going on the attack inevitably/　leaves gaps in one's defense.
Not knowing you were lured out...
I'll cut off your retreat.
How unlike me...!
In that case...!
...That won't decide this.
You exceeded my expectations...
You've earned your way this far, it seems.
Did I misjudge you?
More troublesome than I expected.
So you can hold your own against my Karokuala.
Even with an Earthling at the controls,/　the Throne Unit's power is not to be dismissed.
Do not think you are protected/　by Fureim's blessing.
You lack the finishing touch, Al-Van.
You cannot defeat me,/　the one who sealed Vaula.
The luck that spared you at the Sealed Shrine/　runs out here.
I need not use Larseilam, but I cannot ignore/　a device that interferes with time particles.
To think I'd be pushed this far/　by a mere Bellzelute.
Has the tide turned against me?
You seem to have thought up a few tricks.
Hmph. Not knowing when to quit/　must be their trait too.
Do not think you have the upper hand.
I must change my priorities.
So you're no rank-and-file soldier.
Is that all?/　E-Selda must be lamenting in the grave.
You fall far short of the late Emperor, Shana-Mia.
Impudent, just like E-Selda.
You too played a part in the Assimilation Plan./　I can't let you be.
Because we both pilot Raftclans, is it?
A fake has no more use to us.
Even if you master a scavenged machine...
Vaula's power hasn't faded, it seems.
Hmph... You may have broken Larseilam,/　but this is all you can do?
Every last trace of E-Selda's legacy/　must be wiped away.
Oh? So you touched me.
You caught my Karokuala.
You think that gives you the initiative?
Such attacks are meaningless,/　no matter how often you repeat them.
A feeble move.
You've stepped into my range.
You can't handle the imperial family's sword.
Light cannot erase shadow, Shana-Mia.
It seems the blood of Shune has thinned.
You're no match for E-Selda.
Al-Van misjudged you.
You who can only walk the straight path/　have no chance of victory.
The power of a fake is easy enough to guess.
An Earthling paired with a fake/　can only do so much.
No need to use Larseilam, it seems.
Still no better than a test unit.
A poor move.
The act of a fool.
Laughable.
You cannot catch a shadow.
You'll never avenge your father like that.
You know what I'm capable of.
However you modify that test unit...
E-Selda's last schemes won't work on me.
You carelessly gave away your presence.
I see your impatience.
Such tricks will not work.
Unbreakable.
The outcome was clear.
Know your folly.
The tide seems to be against me...
You'd seal my moves...?
To be worn down this much...
Heh... You're clever, it seems.
You'd escape my eyes...?
The next time you show yourself will be your last.
Did you think I wouldn't move?
I won't miss even a moment's opening.
Don't expect things to go as you plan.
I'll give you no respite.
Again.
Take this blow!
An easy target!
With moves like that?!
Right through!
I'll gouge out your vitals!
I'll blow a hole in you!
All shall be dispersed...!
I'll mow you down...!
At this range...
Fall prey to my sharp claws!
Here I go...!
Orgone Claw!
Got you!
You won't escape!
Heh heh heh...
Take the finishing blow!
Struggle all you like!
I'll shoot you down!
Accept your fate.
Be crushed!
Busker Mode...!
Busker Mode, activate.
Pierce through!
Claw, deploy!
Hahahaha! I'll cut you to pieces!
The darkness of Voda draws near!
Orgone Materialization!
Annihilate!!
Take another!
Gouge! Pare! Flay!/　I'll shred you to bits!
You will soon fall! Into the abyss of Voda!
Slay!!
